job.title: Global South Opportunities
job.location: Work Remotely or In-Person, Lusaka, Zambia
job.description: ZAMSOF is seeking two dedicated and proactive Resource Mobilization Officers (RMOs) to join our team. The successful candidates will be responsible for identifying funding opportunities, building partnerships, and supporting proposal development for programs that strengthen youth leadership and sustainability in the Global South.
